_meta: Premise ledger (audit-2 charter §4 delta 10). Findings overlap in PREMISE, not just in file: retiring one premise fells every dependent finding at once, with the retiring evidence travelling on the flag — and a re-established premise reopens everything built on it. Every verification agent reads this file AND _adjudicated_findings.json unconditionally (shared inventory, never a per-group hint). Statuses: established | retired | open. Add premises at ADJUDICATION time (recording a disproof), not at authoring time — tagging benefits the tagged finding, so the incentive runs the right way (see charter §7 for the rejected author-declared variant).

premises.statement: CV segment ids can be reassigned by a plain re-analysis
premises.evidence: 30 re-analyses, deterministic pipeline — a plain re-analysis cannot reassign anything (_adjudicated_findings.json, A3-IMAGE--1 ruling 2026-08-03)
premises.note: Four agents spent ~1.4M tokens re-deriving this after it was retired — the failure that created this ledger.

premises.statement: Auto (CV) analysis is a routine runtime workflow the card re-runs
